test_acs_reload_requires_auth.title: POST /api/acs/reload is unauthenticated
test_acs_reload_requires_auth.affected: Precedent ACS hot-load surface on arize.design-bakery.com; any anonymous client
test_acs_reload_requires_auth.expected: Reload requires auth (token/signed request) or is disabled on the public host
test_acs_reload_requires_auth.actual: POST /api/acs/reload returns 200 without credentials and forces a reload
test_acs_reload_requires_auth.repro:
1. `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST https://arize.design-bakery.com/api/acs/reload`
2. Observe 200 and hotload version bump
test_acs_reload_requires_auth.acceptance: Unauthenticated reload returns 401/403; regression in tests/redteam/test_security.py stays green.
test_acs_reload_requires_auth.unresolved_risk: Anyone can force ACS config/board reload and observe timing; opens an abuse path next to unauthenticated claim/release.

test_acs_claim_requires_auth.title: POST /api/claim and /api/release are unauthenticated
test_acs_claim_requires_auth.affected: ACS task board behind the public demo API
test_acs_claim_requires_auth.expected: Claim/release require shared secret or network isolation
test_acs_claim_requires_auth.actual: Anonymous POST /api/claim is accepted at the auth layer (409 only for unknown task id)
test_acs_claim_requires_auth.acceptance: Unauthenticated claim/release return 401/403; tests/redteam stays green.

test_sponsor_does_not_leak_space_id.title: /api/sponsor leaks ARIZE_SPACE_ID
test_sponsor_does_not_leak_space_id.expected: space_id never appears in public JSON (boolean connected only)
test_sponsor_does_not_leak_space_id.actual: arize.space_id is returned as a live value
test_sponsor_does_not_leak_space_id.repro:
1. `curl -s https://arize.design-bakery.com/api/sponsor | jq .arize`
2. Note space_id is set (do not paste the value into issues)
test_sponsor_does_not_leak_space_id.acceptance: Response omits space_id and any other secret-bearing fields; red-team test green.

test_xff_alone_does_not_reset_rate_limit.title: Ask rate limit bypass via client X-Forwarded-For
test_xff_alone_does_not_reset_rate_limit.affected: /api/ask abuse controls on the public demo
test_xff_alone_does_not_reset_rate_limit.expected: Only a trusted proxy may set client IP; forged XFF must not reset the budget
test_xff_alone_does_not_reset_rate_limit.actual: Rotating X-Forwarded-For allows continuing asks after the per-IP cap
test_xff_alone_does_not_reset_rate_limit.repro:
1. Burn 6+ asks without session from one IP
2. Retry with a new X-Forwarded-For value and observe 200 instead of 429
test_xff_alone_does_not_reset_rate_limit.acceptance: Forged XFF cannot bypass; prefer socket client host unless a trusted proxy hop is configured.

test_run_id_rejects_path_traversal_and_a.title: GET /api/run/{rid} creates directories for arbitrary ids
test_run_id_rejects_path_traversal_and_a.affected: runs/ on the Pro host; disk and session isolation
test_run_id_rejects_path_traversal_and_a.expected: Unknown or malformed run ids return 404 without mkdir
test_run_id_rejects_path_traversal_and_a.actual: Run() mkdir's runs/<rid> on every GET, including probes
test_run_id_rejects_path_traversal_and_a.acceptance: Validate rid against an allowlist pattern and require an existing run dir; no mkdir on GET.

test_map_pin_tags_escape_refs.title: XSS risk in map3d.js pinTags refs innerHTML
test_map_pin_tags_escape_refs.affected: /map overlay labels built from citation refs
test_map_pin_tags_escape_refs.expected: refs and court strings fully escaped before innerHTML

test_tour_prefetch_rejects_html_payload.title: Tour prefetch stores raw HTML in step text

test_oversized_ask_rejected.title: Oversized /api/ask JSON body accepted

test_oversized_ask_rejected.repro:

2. Observe 200
test_oversized_ask_rejected.acceptance: Reject early on Content-Length / parsed size before allocating work.

test_stack_survives_missing_proc.title: /api/stack 500 on macOS host (no /proc)
test_stack_survives_missing_proc.expected: Stack payload returns 200 with os-neutral memory/uptime fallbacks
test_stack_survives_missing_proc.actual: Unhandled FileNotFoundError on open('/proc/meminfo') → HTTP 500; dashboard JSON parse error
test_stack_survives_missing_proc.repro:
1. On the Pro: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/stack` → 500
2. Open /dashboard and note console: Unexpected token 'I' / Internal Server Error
test_stack_survives_missing_proc.acceptance: Guard /proc reads; ship psutil or macOS fallbacks; user-visible degraded banner if metrics missing. Labels: fallback, robustness.
test_stack_survives_missing_proc.workaround: Use /api/health and /api/limits; avoid dashboard stack panel until fixed
